question: Which one of the following does not come under the primary sector? (RPF Constable 2018 (19/01/2019) Shift 3)
options: Fisheries
Animal Husbandry
Forestry
Oil Refining
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Oil Refining

Explanation:
The primary sector includes economic activities that involve direct exploitation of natural resources, such as agriculture, fisheries, animal husbandry, forestry, mining, etc. Fisheries, Animal Husbandry, and Forestry all fall under the primary sector because they directly use natural resources. On the other hand, Oil Refining is a secondary sector activity, where crude oil is processed to produce petrol, diesel, etc. It is a part of manufacturing, not direct exploitation. Therefore, oil refining does not come under the primary sector.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Main feature of primary sector → Direct exploitation of natural resources
☛ Secondary sector activity → Manufacturing and processing
☛ Oil refining belongs to which sector → Secondary sector
☛ Examples of primary sector → Agriculture, fishing, mining
☛ Three sectors of economy → Primary, secondary, tertiary
question_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा एक प्राथमिक क्षेत्र के अंतर्गत नहीं आता है? (RPF Constable 2018 (19/01/2019) Shift 3)
options_hi: मत्स्यिकी
पशुपालन
वानिकी
तेल शोधन
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है तेल शोधन

Explanation:
प्राथमिक क्षेत्र में वे आर्थिक गतिविधियाँ शामिल हैं जो प्राकृतिक संसाधनों के सीधे दोहन पर आधारित होती हैं, जैसे कृषि, मत्स्यिकी, पशुपालन, वानिकी, खनन आदि। मत्स्यिकी (मछली पकड़ना), पशुपालन और वानिकी सभी प्राथमिक क्षेत्र के अंतर्गत आते हैं क्योंकि ये प्राकृतिक संसाधनों का सीधा उपयोग करते हैं। दूसरी ओर, तेल शोधन एक द्वितीयक क्षेत्र की गतिविधि है, जिसमें कच्चे तेल को रिफाइन करके पेट्रोल, डीजल जैसे उत्पाद बनाए जाते हैं। यह विनिर्माण प्रक्रिया का हिस्सा है, न कि प्राकृतिक संसाधनों का सीधा दोहन। इसलिए, तेल शोधन प्राथमिक क्षेत्र में नहीं आता।

question: __________ refers to the portion of income not spent on consumption. (RPF Constable 2018 (19/01/2019) Shift 3)
options: Collections
Savings
Investing
Streaming
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Savings

Explanation:
Savings refers to the portion of income not spent on consumption. In economics, savings is defined as the difference between income and consumption. It is the part of income set aside for future use rather than current expenditure. Savings is a crucial source of investment and contributes to capital formation in an economy. At the individual level, savings provide financial security, while at the national level, it drives economic growth. A balance between savings and investment is essential for any economy. Savings can be held in various forms such as bank deposits, securities, or physical assets.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Portion of income not spent on consumption → Savings
☛ Primary determinant of savings → Disposable income
☛ Measure of savings in national income accounting → National savings
☛ Equality of savings and investment in classical economics → Through interest rate
☛ India's household savings rate measurement → Gross Domestic Savings (GDS)
question_hi: __________ वह हिस्सा है जो आय में से खपत पर खर्च नहीं किया जाता है। (RPF Constable 2018 (19/01/2019) Shift 3)
options_hi: संग्रह
बचत
निवेश
स्ट्रीमिंग
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है बचत

Explanation:
बचत वह भाग है जो आय में से उपभोग पर खर्च नहीं किया जाता। अर्थशास्त्र में, बचत को आय और उपभोग के अंतर के रूप में परिभाषित किया जाता है। यह भविष्य के उपयोग के लिए आय का वह हिस्सा है जिसे वर्तमान में खर्च नहीं किया जाता। बचत निवेश का एक महत्वपूर्ण स्रोत है और अर्थव्यवस्था में पूंजी निर्माण में सहायक होती है। व्यक्तिगत स्तर पर बचत वित्तीय सुरक्षा प्रदान करती है जबकि राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर यह आर्थिक विकास को गति देती है। बचत और निवेश के बीच संतुलन किसी भी अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए आवश्यक है।

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:

question: What is the deficit budget policy? (RPF Constable 2018 (19/01/2019) Shift 3)
options: Start of new currency in currency supply by central bank
Extended Economic Policy
Reactive Economic Policy
Contradictory Fiscal Policy
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Extended Economic Policy

Explanation:
Deficit budget policy is an Extended Economic Policy where the government spends more than its revenue. Its purpose is to stimulate economic growth, increase demand, and reduce unemployment. This policy is adopted during recessions when private investment and consumption are low. The government increases spending on infrastructure, public services, and welfare programs, boosting the flow of money in the economy. This leads to job creation and an increase in aggregate demand. The deficit is financed through government borrowing, which can increase public debt. It is based on demand-side economics, promoting economic activity through government intervention.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Main objective of deficit budget → Stimulate demand during economic slowdown
☛ Another name for this policy → Expansionary fiscal policy
☛ Underlying theory → Demand-side economics
☛ Potential side effect → Increase in public debt
☛ When is this policy adopted → During recession or slow economic growth
question_hi: घाटे का बजट नीति क्या है? (RPF Constable 2018 (19/01/2019) Shift 3)
options_hi: केंद्रीय बैंक द्वारा मुद्रा आपूर्ति में नई मुद्रा की शुरुआत
विस्तारित आर्थिक नीति
प्रतिक्रियात्मक आर्थिक नीति
विरोधाभासी राजकोषीय नीति
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है विस्तारित आर्थिक नीति

Explanation:
घाटे का बजट नीति एक विस्तारित आर्थिक नीति है, जिसमें सरकार अपने व्यय को राजस्व से अधिक रखती है। इसका उद्देश्य आर्थिक विकास को प्रोत्साहित करना, मांग बढ़ाना और बेरोजगारी कम करना है। यह नीति मंदी के दौरान अपनाई जाती है, जब निजी निवेश और खपत कम होती है। सरकार बुनियादी ढांचे, सार्वजनिक सेवाओं और कल्याण कार्यक्रमों पर अधिक खर्च करती है, जिससे अर्थव्यवस्था में धन का प्रवाह बढ़ता है। इससे रोजगार सृजन होता है और समग्र मांग में वृद्धि होती है। घाटे का बजट सरकारी उधारी द्वारा वित्तपोषित किया जाता है, जो सार्वजनिक ऋण बढ़ा सकता है। यह मांग-पक्ष अर्थशास्त्र पर आधारित है, जो सरकारी हस्तक्षेप के माध्यम से आर्थिक गतिविधियों को प्रोत्साहित करता है।

question: According to the 2011 census, which state of India has the lowest sex ratio? (RPF Constable 2018 (19/01/2019) Shift 3)
options: Kerala
Haryana
Karnataka
Uttar Pradesh
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Haryana

Explanation:
According to the 2011 census, the lowest sex ratio in India was recorded in Haryana at 879 females per 1000 males. This reflects social issues like female foeticide and gender inequality in the state. In contrast, Kerala has the highest sex ratio (1084). Haryana's low sex ratio is mainly attributed to the preference for sons and the dowry system. The government has launched initiatives like 'Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao' to address this issue.

question: Which of the following sources is used to calculate revenue deficit? (RPF Constable 2018 (20/01/2019) Shift 1)
options: Revenue Expenditure - Revenue Receipts
Fiscal receipts - fiscal expenditure
Primary Loss - Net Interest Liabilities
Budget Revenue - Budget Losses
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Revenue Expenditure - Revenue Receipts

Explanation:
Revenue deficit occurs when the government's revenue expenditure exceeds its revenue receipts. It reflects the government's dissavings and is calculated by subtracting Revenue Receipts from Revenue Expenditure. Revenue receipts include tax and non-tax revenues, while revenue expenditure includes expenses on administration, subsidies, and interest payments. Revenue deficit is a key indicator of the government's fiscal health.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is revenue deficit? → Revenue Expenditure - Revenue Receipts
☛ What is fiscal deficit? → Total Expenditure - Total Receipts (excluding borrowings)
☛ How is primary deficit calculated? → Fiscal Deficit - Interest Payments
☛ What is included in revenue receipts? → Tax Revenue and Non-Tax Revenue
☛ Examples of revenue expenditure? → Salaries, Pensions, Subsidies, Interest Payments
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा स्रोत राजस्व घाटे की गणना के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है? (RPF Constable 2018 (20/01/2019) Shift 1)
options_hi: राजस्व व्यय - राजस्व प्राप्तियाँ
राजकोषीय प्राप्तियाँ - राजकोषीय व्यय

solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है राजस्व व्यय - राजस्व प्राप्तियाँ

राजस्व घाटा तब होता है जब सरकार का राजस्व व्यय उसकी राजस्व प्राप्तियों से अधिक होता है। यह सरकार की बचत की कमी को दर्शाता है और इसे राजस्व व्यय में से राजस्व प्राप्तियाँ घटाकर निकाला जाता है। राजस्व प्राप्तियों में कर और गैर-कर राजस्व शामिल हैं, जबकि राजस्व व्यय में प्रशासन, सब्सिडी और ब्याज भुगतान जैसे खर्चे आते हैं। राजस्व घाटा सरकार की वित्तीय स्थिति का एक महत्वपूर्ण संकेतक है।

question: ___________ is a fixed minimum deposit which commercial banks have to keep in reserve with the central bank. (RPF Constable 2018 (20/01/2019) Shift 1)
options: Cash Reserve Ratio
Open Market Operation
Statutory liquidity ratio
Bank Rate
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Cash Reserve Ratio

Explanation:
Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) is a fixed minimum deposit that commercial banks must maintain with the central bank (RBI in India) as a percentage of their total deposits. It is a key tool of monetary policy used to control liquidity in the economy. When the RBI increases the CRR, banks have less money to lend, which helps curb inflation. Conversely, reducing the CRR leaves banks with more funds, encouraging economic growth. Currently, India's CRR is 4%. Among the other options, the Bank Rate is the rate at which RBI lends to banks, Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR) is the percentage of deposits to be maintained in liquid assets like government securities, and Open Market Operations (OMO) involve the buying and selling of government securities.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is the full form of CRR? → Cash Reserve Ratio
☛ What is the current CRR in India? → 4%
☛ Which institution controls CRR in India? → Reserve Bank of India (RBI)
☛ What is the effect of increasing CRR? → Reduces inflation
☛ What is the difference between SLR and CRR? → SLR is in liquid assets; CRR is in cash
question_hi: ___________ वाणिज्यिक बैंकों द्वारा केंद्रीय बैंक के पास रखे जाने वाले न्यूनतम निश्चित जमा को दर्शाता है। (RPF Constable 2018 (20/01/2019) Shift 1)
options_hi: नकद आरक्षित अनुपात
मुक्त बाजार संचालन
वैधानिक तरलता अनुपात
बैंक दर
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है नकद आरक्षित अनुपात

Explanation:
नकद आरक्षित अनुपात (CRR) वह न्यूनतम निश्चित जमा है जो वाणिज्यिक बैंकों को केंद्रीय बैंक (भारत में RBI) के पास रखना आवश्यक होता है। यह बैंक की कुल जमा का एक निर्धारित प्रतिशत होता है। CRR का उपयोग मौद्रिक नीति के तहत अर्थव्यवस्था में तरलता को नियंत्रित करने के लिए किया जाता है। जब RBI CRR बढ़ाता है, तो बैंकों के पास ऋण देने योग्य धन कम हो जाता है, जिससे मुद्रास्फीति नियंत्रित होती है। इसके विपरीत, CRR घटाने से बैंकों के पास अधिक धन उपलब्ध होता है, जो आर्थिक विकास को प्रोत्साहित करता है। वर्तमान में भारत का CRR 4% है। अन्य विकल्पों में, बैंक दर वह दर है जिस पर RBI बैंकों को ऋण देता है, वैधानिक तरलता अनुपात (SLR) सरकारी प्रतिभूतियों में निवेश का अनुपात है, और मुक्त बाजार संचालन (OMO) सरकारी प्रतिभूतियों की खरीद-बिक्री है।

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ CRR का पूरा नाम क्या है? → नकद आरक्षित अनुपात
☛ भारत में वर्तमान CRR कितना है? → 4%
☛ CRR को नियंत्रित करने वाला संगठन कौन सा है? → भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक (RBI)
☛ CRR बढ़ाने का क्या प्रभाव होता है? → मुद्रास्फीति कम होती है
☛ SLR और CRR में क्या अंतर है? → SLR तरल संपत्ति में रखना होता है, CRR नकद में

question: A continuous increase in the normal price level is known as ___________. (RPF Constable 2018 (20/01/2019) Shift 1)
options: Inflation
Financial Crisis
Deflation
Staggering Depression
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Inflation

Explanation:
Inflation is an economic condition characterized by a continuous increase in the general price level. This reduces the purchasing power of money, meaning the same amount of money buys fewer goods and services. Inflation is measured using indices like the Consumer Price Index and Wholesale Price Index. Mild inflation is considered beneficial for economic growth, while excessive inflation can be harmful. The opposite condition, where the price level continuously falls, is called deflation.

☛ What are the types of inflation? → Demand-pull and cost-push inflation
☛ What are the effects of inflation? → Decrease in purchasing power and reduction in debt burden
☛ What is a measure to control inflation? → Contractionary monetary policy, such as raising interest rates
☛ What is the difference between deflation and inflation? → Deflation involves falling prices, while inflation involves rising prices

question: A grant given to reinstate the existing service as a new service is called-  (RPF Constable 2018 (20/01/2019) Shift 2)

solution:

Explanation:

In the government budget process, token grants are used for services that are not seen as a continuation of the previous year's service but are presented as a new initiative. This grant helps in budgetary classification and brings transparency in financial management. The purpose of a token grant is to allow the service to continue until full budgetary approval is received. It acts as a placeholder to maintain the service's existence in the financial records.

Explanation:
A progressive tax is a tax structure where the tax rate increases as the taxable income increases. Its main objective is to reduce income inequality, as higher-income individuals pay a larger percentage of their income in taxes. For example, income tax in India is progressive, with different rates applied to different income slabs. In contrast, a regressive tax sees the tax rate decrease as income rises, such as sales tax. A proportional tax applies the same rate to all income levels. The term disgressive tax is not standard. Progressive taxation is often considered more equitable because it is based on the taxpayer's ability to pay. This system helps fund public services and redistributes wealth from high earners to lower-income groups.

question: Which of the following is the component of M1 in currency supply?  (RPF Constable 2018 (20/01/2019) Shift 3)
options: Investing
Savings
Interest Rate
Money + deposits
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Money + deposits

Explanation:
M1 is the most liquid measure of money supply. It includes currency (notes and coins) held by the public and demand deposits (current and savings account deposits) in banks. M1 represents money available for immediate transactions. Other options like Investing, Savings, and Interest Rate are not components of M1; they are broader economic concepts. The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) publishes four measures of money supply: M0, M1, M2, and M3. M1 is also called 'Narrow Money' because it includes only the most liquid forms of money.

question: 'According to which of the following' the total value of essential commodities in the economy is always equal to the total value of supply?  (RPF Constable 2018 (22/01/2019) Shift 2)
options: Taylor Rule
Law of Walrus
WebLyn Effect
Rule From
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Law of Walrus

Explanation:
Walras' Law is a key economic principle stating that the total value of all goods and services demanded in an economy always equals the total value of their supply. It was formulated by French economist Léon Walras and forms the foundation of general equilibrium theory. According to this law, if there is equilibrium in (n-1) markets, the nth market will automatically be in equilibrium. This implies that excess demand or excess supply cannot exist simultaneously across all markets. In essence, the sum of excess demands across all markets is zero. This law is crucial for understanding how markets clear and resources are allocated efficiently.

वालरस का नियम (Walras' Law) एक महत्वपूर्ण आर्थिक सिद्धांत है जो बताता है कि किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में सभी वस्तुओं और सेवाओं की कुल मांग का मूल्य, उनकी कुल आपूर्ति के मूल्य के बराबर होता है। इसे फ्रांसीसी अर्थशास्त्री लियोन वालरस ने प्रतिपादित किया था। यह नियम सामान्य संतुलन सिद्धांत का आधार है, जिसमें यदि (n-1) बाजारों में संतुलन है, तो nवां बाजार भी स्वतः संतुलन में होगा। इसका अर्थ है कि अतिरिक्त मांग या आपूर्ति असंभव है। यह नियम कहता है कि सभी बाजारों की कुल अतिरिक्त मांग शून्य होती है।

question: Which of the following is called a money market? (RPF Constable 2018 (22/01/2019) Shift 2)
options: Working Capital Markets
Lively Market
Initial Market
Direct Market
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Working Capital Markets

Explanation:
Money market is a financial market where short-term debt instruments are traded. It is also called the working capital market because it meets the working capital needs of companies. Its maturity period is less than one year. It includes instruments like Treasury bills, commercial paper, certificates of deposit, and call money. This market helps in liquidity management and is used by central banks for monetary policy operations. Other options like Lively Market, Initial Market, and Direct Market are not synonyms for money market.

question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किसे मनी मार्केट कहा जाता है? (RPF Constable 2018 (22/01/2019) Shift 2)

question: Which of the following is not revenue expenditure for the government? (RPF Constable 2018 (22/01/2019) Shift 2)
options: Subsidy
Interest Payment
Defense Expenses
Tax Collection
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Tax Collection

Explanation:
Government's revenue expenditure refers to expenses incurred for day-to-day functioning and services, such as subsidies, interest payments, and defense expenses. These are operational costs that do not create assets. Tax collection, on the other hand, is a source of revenue for the government, not an expenditure. Revenue expenditure consumes the government's income, while tax collection adds to it. Thus, tax collection is not a revenue expenditure; it is a revenue receipt. This distinction is crucial for understanding government budgeting and fiscal policy.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:

☛ Example of capital expenditure → Infrastructure development like roads.

☛ Subsidy is which type of expenditure? → Revenue expenditure.
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सरकार के लिए राजस्व व्यय नहीं है? (RPF Constable 2018 (22/01/2019) Shift 2)

रक्षा व्यय

question: Each production is possible by combining land, labor, physical capital and human capital- (RPF Constable 2018 (22/01/2019) Shift 3)

question: Government's removal of government restrictions and barriers is known as -  (RPF Constable 2018 (22/01/2019) Shift 3)

Personalization
Modernization
Industrialization
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Liberalization

Explanation:
Liberalization refers to the removal of government restrictions and barriers in the economy. It is a process of economic reforms that reduces state control and allows greater freedom to the private sector. In India, liberalization was adopted in 1991 with economic reforms that ended the license raj and promoted foreign investment. The goal of liberalization is to make the market more competitive and accelerate economic growth. Other options like personalization (making personal), modernization (making modern), and industrialization (development of industries) are incorrect.

question_hi: सरकार द्वारा सरकारी प्रतिबंधों और बाधाओं को हटाने को क्या कहा जाता है? (RPF Constable 2018 (22/01/2019) Shift 3)

वैयक्तिकरण
आधुनिकीकरण
औद्योगीकरण

question: The property that is held by the recipient and which he uses as a lender's guarantee until the loan is paid, is called- (RPF Constable 2018 (22/01/2019) Shift 3)
options: Ability to borrow
Property
Unsecured Loans
Collaborative Contract
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Collaborative Contract

Explanation:
The concept described in the question is 'Collateral Contract' (translated as Collaborative Contract in Hindi). It refers to an agreement where a borrower pledges an asset (like property) to a lender as security for a loan. If the borrower defaults, the lender can seize and sell the asset to recover the loan amount. This reduces the lender's risk and makes the loan secured. 'Ability to borrow' relates to creditworthiness, 'Property' is a general term, and 'Unsecured Loans' involve no collateral. Hence, the correct answer is 'Collaborative Contract', which is essentially a collateralized loan arrangement. In legal terms, it's a contract that supports a primary loan agreement.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is a collateral contract? → Property held as guarantee for loan repayment.
☛ Example of secured loan? → Home loan, car loan with pledged asset.
☛ What is an unsecured loan? → No collateral required, e.g., credit card debt.
☛ What is pledged property called? → Collateral.
☛ Purpose of collateral contract? → Protect lender from default.
question_hi: ऋणी द्वारा रखी गई संपत्ति, जिसका उपयोग वह ऋण चुकाने तक ऋणदाता की गारंटी के रूप में करता है, उसे क्या कहा जाता है? (RPF Constable 2018 (22/01/2019) Shift 3)
options_hi: उधार लेने की क्षमता
संपत्ति
असुरक्षित ऋण
सहयोगी अनुबंध
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है सहयोगी अनुबंध

Explanation:
प्रश्न में वर्णित अवधारणा 'सहयोगी अनुबंध' (Collateral Contract) है। यह एक प्रकार का अनुबंध है जिसमें ऋणी अपनी किसी संपत्ति को ऋणदाता के पास गिरवी रखता है ताकि ऋण चुकाने तक वह गारंटी के रूप में काम करे। यदि ऋणी ऋण चुकाने में विफल रहता है, तो ऋणदाता उस संपत्ति को बेचकर अपना पैसा वसूल कर सकता है। यह एक सुरक्षित ऋण का रूप है, जो ऋणदाता के जोखिम को कम करता है। 'उधार लेने की क्षमता' (Ability to borrow) क्रेडिट योग्यता से संबंधित है, 'संपत्ति' (Property) सामान्य शब्द है, और 'असुरक्षित ऋण' (Unsecured Loans) में कोई गारंटी नहीं होती। इसलिए, सही उत्तर 'सहयोगी अनुबंध' है।
